claim_boundary: This file separates verified finite facts, external theorems and unproved transfer lemmas. No chain resolves P versus NP.

chains.name: Policy-0A execution to JANUS-FC_local certificate
premises_verified: Exact canonical residual keys are recorded after exhaustive unit propagation.
Every cache target is completed earlier in DFS order.
Unit, local Resolution and branch transitions are replayed.
A separate serialized verifier rejects corrupted target, result, key and context records.
Production and traced counters agree on 1,200 random non-affine UNSAT formulas and structured fixtures.
chains.missing_bridge: A universal execution/certificate induction and polynomial construction/replay theorem including canonicalization and lookup costs.
chains.forbidden_conclusion: Finite replay does not prove universal soundness or polynomial-time SAT.

chains.name: Exact Boolean cache to one reusable reason
premises_verified: MAJ3-K4 has 438 directly reused exact residual states and 1,326 direct contexts.
In the unfolded C022 clause language only five direct states admit one reason covering all direct contexts.
Four hundred twenty-two direct states require a distinct emitted reason for every direct context.
Inherited unit consequences appear in 1,082 repeated-state occurrences.
chains.external_theorem: Reason-plus-weakening and stronger clause-learning systems can exceed basic exact Formula Caching and may simulate regular or general Resolution under their stated rules.
chains.missing_bridge: An explicit polynomial reason language and extraction certificate, or a lower bound proving no such reason exists for a specified system.
chains.forbidden_conclusion: Failure of the unfolded C022 reason language does not rule out all polynomial reason systems.

chains.name: Historical graph-tautology Formula-Caching lower bound to JANUS-FC_local
premises_verified: GT_n exact Policy-0A state counts grow from 1 to 4,001 for n=3..9.
Removing local Resolution raises GT_9 states from 4,001 to 6,230.
Weakening/Subsumption lookup saves one GT_8 state while charging 26,159,347 clause-pair checks.
GT_8 local Resolution emits 18,014 resolvent occurrences, 11,897 of them repeated, dominated by widths three and four.
Only 48 GT_8 emitted resolvents are units and the second propagation phase records 182 unit events.
chains.external_theorem: Basic Formula Caching with Weakening/Subsumption requires at least 2^(n-2) nodes on graph tautologies under the historical system definition.
chains.missing_bridge: Prove the historical witness invariant robust under Policy-0A's deterministic one-pass local Resolution, or simulate that pass inside the historical system with polynomial overhead.
chains.forbidden_conclusion: The historical FCWS theorem cannot yet be quoted as a lower bound for JANUS-FC_local.

chains.name: C022 MAJ3 no-cache lower bound to exact cached Policy-0A
premises_verified: The MAJ3 affine dispatcher remains inactive.
Policy-0A uses 2,427 unique states and 888 exact hits on MAJ3-K4.
The exact FC certificate has 50,796 charged records.
Full unfolding has 15,671 calls and yields a 149,030-line Resolution proof.
Global clause deduplication yields a valid 93,394-line Resolution DAG.
chains.external_theorem: C022 gives an exponential lower-bound chain for the exact no-cache non-affine Policy-0T core, conditional on its registered review boundary.
chains.missing_bridge: A polynomial cache-composition or reusable-reason rule preserving the depth/size parameters, or a direct lower bound for the residual-judgement DAG calculus.
chains.forbidden_conclusion: The no-cache lower bound does not transfer through memoization by counting unique residual states.
